name: Compact
author: Freek van Gool
description: A compact layout for small screens: rotary knobs with the value and name underneath, grouped per section (level, tone, compressor, limiter) in one frame each, at about three quarters of the standard width and roughly half the height.

appearances.name: Compact
appearances.description: Rotary knobs, grouped and tight, at a smaller width and height than the standard card.
